reconstruction.requirements: Python 3 standard library only. JSON is the only input file.
reconstruction.steps: Save python3_decoder as restore.py. Run either command below. Output paths are overwritten if they exist.
reconstruction.original_guarantee: Exact restoration of the public source PNG, with one opaque ancillary metadata identifier removed before packaging. RGBA pixels are unchanged.
reconstruction.raster_guarantee: Same RGBA samples, independently re-encoded as a fresh PNG.

raster.coordinate_system: zero-based upper-left origin, x rightward, y downward
raster.tile_layout: interleaved RGBA bytes, rows top to bottom, no padding

study.region_bounds: Approximate overlapping inspection windows [x0,y0,x1,y1); not masks

regions.observation: Pale crown, black diagonal band, dominant cyan-blue optic, and partially visible far optic.
Angular warm-red brow above the dark eye. Face turns toward image right.
Near ear with a small warm-metal hoop.
Teeth exposed above an angular red-orange element with a narrow yellow edge.
Tall pointed form with dark and muted bronze bands.
Opposing pointed form with differing slope and projection.
Diagonal dark sleeve silhouette with repeated short projections, ending by the visible hand.
Long dark sleeve and dense cuff. Cuff interrupts the shaft outline.
Pale cream-to-lilac areas with branching dark lines and overlapping black straps.
Crossed straps and two pairs of warm-colored rings. Lower rings are partly occluded.
Pale outlined fingers close around a diagonal dark form.
Dark angular silhouette crosses in front of the upper image-left leg.
Pale angular relief-like silhouette with paired swept sides and dark openings.
Large circular knee center and stacked black, gray and bronze plates. Leg continues past frame.
Four reddish-ended protrusions along the outer thigh silhouette.
Bent leg with narrower projected plates, smaller protrusions and a visible pointed boot.
Curved shaft with narrow highlight and cuff occlusion.
Dark hook silhouette with a white cut-in between tips.

overlap_observations: Diagonal accessory in front of image-left upper leg
study.preservation: Includes all source samples, including background, near-black detail and edge specks. No cleanup, resampling, or color conversion.
